The milestone is empty and this is the first spine scene. I need to build a single irreversible scene from the committed world state.

The player names a commission that governs the toll road. I must decide whether to adopt this body as canon or keep it provisional.

The scene must be a single irreversible state change. I will structure the JSON output and identify the exact fact that flips from false to true when the player sends the sealed word.

The commission will be treated as durable canon. The scene will open with the precondition that it has not yet received the sealed demand, then show the letter arriving at its chambers.

The output must be pure JSON with the required keys and continuation envelope. The tactical move is to initiate a formal inquiry by notifying the governing body.
